item.title: Do Programmable Thermostats Actually Cut Heating Bills?
item.description:
The self-programming option Google Nest Learning Thermostat (4th gen)

A programmable thermostat saves only if you actually program it. The Nest programs itself — learning your schedule in a week and cutting heating ~12% and cooling ~15% on its own.
